system.description: Granted by the Liturgist archetype. Use the Liturgist feat to record the four Divinity spells you can cast when the feat is taken, to record further eligible Divinity spells learned from written sources, and to make the daily selection: the chosen spell goes on your spells table until your next daily preparation — for a learned caster memorised without counting against the memorised total, for an instinctive caster in the repertoire for the day. Liturgy of Prayer reaches one in the moment.
